info.name: Rodha Package Add-ons (FE)
info.description:
Add-ons (course, buddy package or book) linked to a website package. Students buy them with the package, later for a package they own, or during an upgrade. Promocodes never apply to add-ons.

Example data is illustrative. Examples marked (trimmed) show only the fields relevant to add-ons. Errors: { success: false, message, errors }.
